patterns.name: unexpected_administrator_group_change
patterns.evidence: Confirmed administrator group change accompanied by an unusual source, ordinary-account promotion, rapid re-addition or correlated simultaneous privileged action.

patterns.name: recent_privilege_gain_and_command
patterns.evidence: Administrator command executed immediately after gaining administrative privileges.

patterns.name: unusual_privileged_command
patterns.evidence: Administrator command executed from an unfamiliar source, outside usual hours, or using another account's privileges.

patterns.name: unusual_privileged_session_change
patterns.evidence: Confirmed unexpected session privilege elevation associated with an unfamiliar source.

patterns.name: privilege_context_needs_review
patterns.evidence: Privilege-related activity without enough corroboration for an automatic block.

guardrails: A MITRE label, high rule level, administrator username or mere group query never authorizes blocking.
Cancelled/failed attempts, routine authorized administration and low-confidence changes are not blocked.
Block requires a valid source address, identified source account, high severity and correlated privilege change/command evidence.
Only fields of an individual alert are used; no cross-alert state, imports, I/O, networking or secret material.
Block is a classifier label for synthetic course fixtures, not proof of enforced access revocation.
